# jumpcloud_ip_list (Resource)

Manages a JumpCloud IP list for conditional access policies.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jumpcloud_ip_list" "office" {
  name        = "Office Egress"
  description = "Public IP ranges for corporate offices"
  ips = [
    "203.0.113.0/24",
    "198.51.100.42",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ips` (List of String) List of IP addresses or CIDR ranges.
- `name` (String) The name of the IP list.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the IP list.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the IP list.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import jumpcloud_ip_list.example <ip-list-id>
```
